name: @adr/app
//dependencies: BOTH HALVES of every block's pair. The root is the one package permitted to name an adapter leaf at all - it is what binds a port to a live client - and that permission is declared here rather than assumed.
//exports: EMPTY, NOT ABSENT. The composition root is the one package nothing may import, and an absent map does not say so: MEASURED, with no `exports` field `@adr/app` was TS2307 as a BARE specifier while `@adr/app/contract` resolved clean from inside a block, because a manifest without the field falls back to directory resolution. `{}` denies every subpath. The root spans every package and is spanned by none.
